svg.text: $ ipa-diagnose (exit 2)
REAL LIVE CAPTURE - FreeIPA 4.13.4 / Fedora 43 lab - commit b58f3d6, run 36742907611
Host: ipa01.lab.test Generated: 2026-09-30T16:27:30Z
Overall: CRITICAL
Evidence: PARTIAL
RUV state: NOT VERIFIED - ipa-replica-manage list -v ipa01.lab.test exited 1: ; ipa-replica-manage list-ruv exited 1:
; read-only LDAPI fallback unavailable: ldapsearch exited 255: ldap_sasl_interactive_bind: Can't contact LDAP server
(-1); ldapsearch exited 255 (CA suffix): ldap_sasl_interactive_bind: Can't contact LDAP... (this is NOT a stale-RUV
finding; stale replica metadata could not be checked)
NOT VERIFIED: ipa-healthcheck coverage (Directory Server and IPA checks) - ipa-healthcheck reported no
ipahealthcheck.ds.* checks; a full run always does, so health cannot be verified from this output
ROOT CAUSE
Required service 'dirsrv' is not running
WHY
ipa-healthcheck (ipahealthcheck.meta.services.dirsrv) directly reports: dirsrv: not running. This is the check's own
statement, not an inference. Why the service is not running is NOT determined by this finding.
EVIDENCE
✓ ipa-healthcheck states this service is not running.
CHECKED FOR YOU
Read-only checks ipa-diagnose ran on this host just now (results, not problems):
- Privileges: running as root
- State of dirsrv: dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service: inactive (dead)
- Recent log of dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service: last log line: dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service: Consumed 10.523s CPU time, 99.8M
memory peak.
IMPACT
Functions that depend on this service are unavailable or degraded. Other failures in this report (for example
ipa-healthcheck checks that could not connect) may be consequences.
FIX
Start the stopped service - 1 step on this server, run by you (ipa-diagnose never runs a fix itself).
1. Start only dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service; no other service is started or stopped
systemctl start dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service
expected: the command returns without an error and dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service is active. If it fails, it stays
stopped and systemctl status shows why
PREREQUISITES
✓ ipa-diagnose is running as root (starting a system service needs root) (checked)
WHAT THIS CHANGES
- dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service goes from inactive to running. No configuration, data or other service is changed.
RISK
MEDIUM - changes a running system; read each step before running it
ROLLBACK
- Stop it again (back to the state it was in)
systemctl stop dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service
VERIFY
After the fix, run (on the server):
sudo ipa-diagnose verify
It re-runs the diagnosis and checks, with fresh evidence:
- dirsrv@LAB-TEST.service is active
LIMITATIONS
This starts the one stopped service; it does not establish why it stopped. If it stopped because of a failure (see the
last result and log line above), the same cause can stop it again. ipactl start is deliberately not used: if any IPA
service fails to start, ipactl stops all IPA services.
